_comment: Manual matches that override the automatic alignment, kept only where the text supports them and the automatic matching misses them (short sentences or reworded list items). Key = article number in the draft; value = current article numbers ("24" = the whole article, "24§1" = its first paragraph). "_removed" forces current articles to show as removed. Each entry was checked by hand against the texts on 2026-11-23: 3 (human being the highest value) = draft 19 §1; 23 (dignity) = draft 20 item 2; 24 §1 (right to life) = draft 20 item 1; 24 §2-3 (arbitrary deprivation of life, death penalty) = draft 23 items 2 and 1; 45 §1 (freedom of association) = draft 20 item 27; 61 (judicial protection) = draft 20 item 21; 68 (double jeopardy) = draft 23 item 14; 80 (essence of rights inviolable) = draft 24 §4; 153 (Government sessions) = draft 54 §3; 192 (Ombudsman election) = draft 74 §4.
